evidence.description: Memory map shows UA_BA @ 0xB800_8000 - 0xB800_8FFF for UART Control Registers
UART controller overview and dual-channel description (UART0 high-speed with CTS/RTS, UART1 normal speed)
Ghidra scalar search for 0xB8008000 returned 0 matches (no firmware register touches observed)
Bootloader image also has no scalar references to UA_BA

raw_note: Verified via N3290x Design Guide memory map (pages 47-49) and UART section (pages 750-754). Scalar search for 0xB8008000 found no firmware references in APP or BOOT images, suggesting UART is unused in these builds. No functions/strings containing "uart" were found; any init routine would thus be a no-op/stub (nop-loop) with no UA_BA register touches.
summary: UART peripheral base is UA_BA @ 0xB800_8000–0xB800_8FFF per N3290x memory map. Datasheet section 6.22 documents two UART channels (UART0 high-speed with flow control, UART1 normal-speed). Firmware scalar searches in both ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin and ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin show no direct accesses to this base, implying UART is likely unused in these builds.
title: MMIO UART Controller (UA_BA @ 0xB8008000)
